;Armed attacks and conflicts
*A [[Saudis|Saudi]] national opens fire at the Al-Salam Royal Palace in [[Jeddah]], [[Saudi Arabia]], killing two guards and injuring three others. Security guards shoot and kill the gunman. [http://www.arabnews.com/node/1173966/saudi-arabia (''Arab News'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-41540379 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2017 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Nate (2017)|Hurricane Nate]]
***Hurricane Nate makes landfall near the mouth of [[Mississippi River]] and near [[Biloxi, Mississippi]], as a [[Category 1 hurricane]] with maximum sustained winds of {{convert|85|mph|kph}}. [http://wjla.com/news/nation-world/hurricane-nate-makes-landfall-as-category-1-storm (WJLA)]
**Aftermath of [[Hurricane Maria]]
***The [[Federal Communications Commission]] approves [[Google]]'s plan to restore some cell phone service in hurricane-hit [[Puerto Rico]] with [[Project Loon]] balloons. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/10/07/google-gets-go-ahead-restore-cell-phone-service-puerto-rico/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*An explosion at a [[liquefied natural gas]] depot leads to a second explosion at a gas station in [[Legon]], a suburb of the [[Ghana]]ian capital [[Accra]], killing at least seven people and injuring sixty-eight more. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/10/07/official-ghana-gas-station-explosions-kill-number-people.html (AP via Fox News)] [http://starrfmonline.com/2017/10/07/massive-gas-explosion-madina/ (StarrFM)]
*[[Pneumonic plague#Madagascar|2017 Madagascar plague outbreak]]
**Since August 1, another round of [[pneumonic plague|pneumonic]], [[bubonic plague|bubonic]], and [[septicemic plague|septicemic]]  plague spreads in [[Madagascar]], killing at least 45 people. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2017/10/05/black-death-outbreak-strikes-madagascar-killing-30-and-triggering-panic/?utm_term=.044a2d0a91dd (''The Washington Post'')] [https://reliefweb.int/report/madagascar/plague-outbreak-madagascar-external-situation-report-02-9-october-2017 (Relief Web)]
*A car mounts the pedestrian sidewalk near the [[Natural History Museum, London|Natural History Museum]] on [[Exhibition Road]], and injures 11 people. [[London]] police believe the incident is not terror related. They arrested the driver but later released him. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-41541165 (BBC)]
